implementationSteps.title: Assess Your Growing Space
implementationSteps.description: Evaluate location, sunlight, and soil conditions
implementationSteps.details: Spend time observing your proposed garden location throughout the day. Note: Which areas get full sun (6+ hours)? Which get partial shade? Check soil drainage by watering and observing. Take photos from different angles. Measure total available space in square meters.

implementationSteps.title: Test Your Soil
implementationSteps.details: Collect soil samples from 3-4 different areas. Use pH strips to test acidity (vegetables like 6.0-7.0 pH). Check for texture: add water and squeeze - sandy (falls apart), loamy (holds together), clay (very sticky). If testing reveals problems, note improvement options (add compost, sand, etc).

implementationSteps.title: Select Vegetables for Your Climate
implementationSteps.description: Choose varieties that will thrive in your region
implementationSteps.details: Research vegetables suited to your climate zone. Consider your rainfall, temperature range, and season length. Make a list of 8-10 vegetables you want to grow. Note planting times (early season, mid-season, late season). Check seed availability in local markets.

implementationSteps.title: Design Your Garden Layout
implementationSteps.description: Create a plan showing plant placement and spacing
implementationSteps.details: Draw your garden space to scale on paper. Mark sun exposure areas. Plan bed location (south-facing for sun). Calculate spacing: small plants (20cm apart), medium (30-40cm), large (50cm+). Plan irrigation access. Show pathways between beds. Take measurements and calculations to neighbors for feedback.

implementationSteps.title: Gather Materials and Tools
implementationSteps.description: Collect everything needed to start your garden
implementationSteps.details: Make a checklist: spade, hoe, rake, watering can, compost, mulch, fencing (if needed). Get quotes from suppliers. Calculate total startup cost. Identify where each item can be sourced locally. Plan purchasing timeline.

implementationSteps.title: Connect with Local Gardeners
implementationSteps.details: Find local gardening groups or agricultural extension office. Interview 3-4 experienced gardeners about what grows well locally. Ask about common pests/diseases. Exchange contact information. Arrange to visit someone's garden to observe techniques.

successCriteria: Completed soil assessment with pH and texture analysis
Have a hand-drawn or digital garden layout with measurements
Created a list of 8-10 vegetables suited to your climate with planting times
Know the startup cost and have sourcing plan for materials
Established contact with at least 2 local experienced gardeners
Can explain 3 key success factors for vegetable gardening in your area

options: D) Vegetables can grow in shade

options: C) Guaranteed to never need pesticides

implementationSteps.title: Set Up Your Workspace
implementationSteps.description: Create a safe welding practice area
implementationSteps.details: Find a well-ventilated area with: concrete floor, away from flammable materials, good lighting. Set up a sturdy work table (height ~90cm). Clear area of paper, cloth, combustibles. Locate fire extinguisher and first aid kit nearby. Have water source accessible. Ensure proper ventilation (open windows or exhaust fan).

implementationSteps.title: Gather and Inspect Safety Equipment
implementationSteps.details: Check each item: helmet lens clarity (not cracked), gloves for holes or tears, safety glasses, boots sole integrity, apron condition. Test helmet's automatic darkening feature (if electronic). Keep safety equipment easily accessible. Never weld without full PPE. Have backup helmet if possible.

implementationSteps.title: Inspect Welding Equipment
implementationSteps.details: Inspect: welding torch for damage, gas hose connections (no leaks), ground clamp condition, electrical cord safety, gas tank security. Check fuel type and ensure correct for your process. Read equipment manual completely. Note contact info for equipment repairs. Practice turning machine on/off safely.

implementationSteps.title: Learn Safety Procedures
implementationSteps.details: Memorize: fire safety procedures, emergency shut-off locations, rescue techniques, burn treatment. Practice putting on and taking off all safety gear correctly. Review hand signals for communication. Understand ventilation requirements. Know how to report hazards. Create a safety checklist for your workspace.

implementationSteps.title: Prepare Welding Materials
implementationSteps.details: Collect metal samples: mild steel preferred for beginners, various thicknesses (1-5mm). Get welding wire appropriate for your machine. Organize storage so materials are accessible but safe. Mark scrap area away from work zone. Label all materials clearly. Have extras for failed welds.

implementationSteps.title: Create Your Safety Protocol
implementationSteps.details: Write down: daily pre-work checklist (inspect equipment, check ventilation), emergency procedures (fire, burn, electrical), cleanup procedures, accident reporting process. Post checklist visibly. Share with anyone who may use your space. Review and update as you learn more. Never skip safety steps.

successCriteria: Workspace is properly set up with good ventilation and lighting
All safety equipment is available, inspected, and in good condition
Welding machine is inspected and functioning properly
Can explain 5 key safety rules without looking at notes
Have practice materials organized and ready
Can don and doff full safety gear in under 2 minutes
Created written safety protocol for your space

modules.title: English Basics: Greetings & Introductions
learningObjectives: Learn basic English greetings and responses

videos.title: Basic English Greetings
videos.description: Learn how to greet people formally and informally

videos.title: Introducing Yourself
videos.description: Say your name, age, and basic information about yourself

videos.title: Pronunciation Guide: Common Greetings
videos.description: Perfect your pronunciation of important phrases

videos.title: Polite Expressions & Please/Thank You
videos.description: Learn essential polite ways to communicate

videos.title: Listening Practice: Native Speakers
videos.description: Listen to real native speaker conversations

implementationSteps.title: Learn Key Greeting Phrases
implementationSteps.details: Study these phrases: Hello / Hi, Good morning / afternoon / evening, How are you?, I'm fine thank you, Nice to meet you, See you later, Goodbye. Write each in your notebook. Say each one aloud 5 times. Record yourself and listen. Compare with video.

implementationSteps.title: Practice Your Introduction
implementationSteps.details: Write your introduction: My name is ___. I am from ___. I work/study as ___. I am ___ years old. Practice saying it smoothly without notes. Record yourself. Check pronunciation against native speaker. Practice 10 times until comfortable.

implementationSteps.title: Learn Polite Expressions
implementationSteps.details: Study: Please, Thank you, You're welcome, Excuse me, I'm sorry, That's OK. Practice in context: 'Please pass the water', 'Thank you for helping me'. Practice with a partner saying these phrases naturally.

implementationSteps.title: Pronunciation Practice
implementationSteps.description: Improve how you sound when speaking English
implementationSteps.details: Focus on: stress (which word sounds louder), rhythm, connected speech. Record yourself saying key phrases. Compare with native speaker videos. Slow down audio and repeat. Practice problem sounds multiple times.

implementationSteps.title: Real Conversation Practice
implementationSteps.details: Find a practice partner (friend, classmate, online partner). Role-play conversations: greetings, introductions, simple small talk. Spend 15+ minutes in English conversation. Note new words. Repeat difficult parts. Ask partner for feedback.

implementationSteps.title: Self-Assessment
implementationSteps.description: Evaluate your progress and identify areas to improve
implementationSteps.details: Record yourself having a 2-minute conversation. Listen and evaluate: Do I understand all words? Can I respond to questions? Is my pronunciation clear? What was difficult? What was easy? Make notes for improvement.

successCriteria: Can greet someone and respond to greetings naturally
Can introduce yourself with name, age, and occupation
Use polite expressions appropriately in conversation
Pronunciation is clear enough for native speakers to understand
Can understand and respond to basic questions about yourself
Can have a 2-minute simple conversation in English

quiz.question: What is the most common way to greet someone in English?
